name: Customer support
arc: The condition that spreads. Three of nine, ask, rung one fails, rung two fails. Then six of nine on the same file, and the route changes to content.
intendedRoutesNeed: a file whose negative chips are mostly internal. MA-L-096 is entirely neutral, so a majority-neutral signal takes the content route at any share (spec 4.6) and the route cannot change as share crosses half.
